WITH CTE1 AS(
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) COUNT_TGT, 
    SUM(TS_CNT) TS_CNT_TGT,
    FILE_NAME, 
    INSERT_DTTM 
  FROM 
    d360.STG_EDS_DEP_FCFTT 
  WHERE 
    H = 'D' 
  GROUP BY 
    FILE_NAME, 
    INSERT_DTTM
), 
CTE2 AS (
  SELECT 
    REPLACE(H, 'F-', '') COUNT_SRC, 
    TS_CNT TS_CNT_SRC,
    FILE_NAME, 
    INSERT_DTTM 
  FROM 
    d360.STG_EDS_DEP_FCFTT 
  WHERE 
    H <> 'D'
), 
CTE12 as (
  SELECT 
    COUNT_SRC, 
    COUNT_TGT, 
    TS_CNT_SRC,
    TS_CNT_TGT,
    A.FILE_NAME, 
    A.INSERT_DTTM, 
    CONVERT(
      DATE, 
      (
        left(
          right(A.FILE_NAME, 12), 
          8
        )
      )
    ) DATE 
  FROM 
    CTE1 A 
    JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME 
    AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
) 

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL] 
SELECT 
  FILE_NAME, 
  DATE, 
  insert_dttm, 
  REPLACE(METRICS, '_SRC', '') METRICS, 
  SRC, 
  TGT 
FROM 
  (
    SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC,
    CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT,
    CAST(TS_CNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TS_CNT_SRC,
    CAST(TS_CNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TS_CNT_TGT,
    FILE_NAME,
    INSERT_DTTM,
    [DATE]
    FROM 
      CTE12
  ) src UNPIVOT (
    SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC,TS_CNT_SRC)
  ) pvt1 UNPIVOT (
    TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT,TS_CNT_TGT)
  ) pvt2

WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
